name: Sledge
title: AI-powered construction finance platform
description: Sledge is a desktop web app for construction subcontractors. It pulls bills out of email, ties every dollar to a project, chases lien waivers and pays vendors without leaving the job.

meta.label: Project
meta.value: AI construction platform · AP & job costing

meta.label: Discipline
meta.value: UX / UI · Web app · Dark UI

challenge.heading: Construction runs on paper
paragraphs: A subcontractor’s back office lives in inboxes, spreadsheets and folders of signed PDFs. AP teams retyped vendor bills, chased lien waivers by hand and found out at month end that balances didn’t match.
Nobody had one view of contract, billed, collected and cost per project, and the same invoice arriving from two inboxes could be paid twice.
The goal: one place where every bill, waiver and dollar is tied to the job it came from, and paying is one click.

rows.heading: Two connections, six short steps
rows.text: First-time setup asks for only two things: the inbox where bills arrive and the accounting platform. A new project is a six-step wizard, or one upload: drop a signed contract and Sledge fills the project in.
rows.caption: Setup · Gmail / Outlook and QuickBooks

rows.heading: Every job on one map
rows.text: Projects sit in the middle of everything. They open as cards beside a live map, and each one has a photo banner with contract amount, client and timeline, plus Home and Accounting tabs.
rows.caption: Projects · grid with map

rows.heading: From inbox to paid in four moves
rows.text: Bills move through Importing, Needs review, Approved and Paid. Review puts the PDF beside the form so nothing is retyped, duplicates are flagged before approval, and paying a batch goes through Stripe with the fee shown first.
rows.caption: Bill detail · PDF, fields and duplicate warning

outcome.title: Nothing retyped
outcome.text: Bills are read straight out of Gmail and Outlook and checked side by side with the original PDF.

outcome.title: Job costs in view
outcome.text: Receivables, payables and net cash lead every project, with expenses and profit margin below.

outcome.title: Gold does the pointing
outcome.text: A dark UI for long sessions; one gold accent marks the active item and what needs attention.
